game_concept: A speed quiz set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Counter Tower: Increase a counter variable every time arrows reach the market bell, stacking the tower higher.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Postern Gate, repeat each round: Increase a counter variable every time arrows reach the market bell, stacking the tower higher. Each round, a new arrows challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the delivered value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Counter Tower
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Counter Tower' (Week 1 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Postern Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how delivered changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Postern Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 36 seconds.
